hooks.command: marker="/tmp/claude-hft-session-start-$(printf %s "$PWD" | shasum | cut -d' ' -f1)"; changes=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | grep -v '^?? docs/CLAUDE.local.md$'); if [ -n "$changes" ] && [ -f docs/log.md ] && [ -f "$marker" ] && [ ! docs/log.md -nt "$marker" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "提醒：本次会话有未记录的项目改动，请更新 docs/log.md（人物数据同步 people-entry-log.md）后再结束。"}'; fi
